REPEAT 10 main
END

main:
GOTO create save
GOTO pan
GOTO quit game
GOTO load game
GOTO quit game
GOTO delete save
END
//clicks new game, types auto generated save and clicks done
create save:
MOVE 492 244
MOVE 493 244
MBP 0
MBR 0
MOVE 28 61
MBP 0
MBR 0
TYPE auto generated save
MOVE 36 166
MBP 0
MBR 0
END

pan:
MOVE 850 200
MBP 0
MOVE 300 200
MBR 0

quit game:
KBP 36
KBR 36
MOVE 29 59
MBP 0
MBR 0
END

load game:
MOVE 500 300
MBP 0
MBR 0
MOVE 50 75
MBP 0
MBR 0
END

delete save:
MOVE 500 300
MBP 0
MBR 0
MOVE 280 75
MBP 0
MBR 0
KBP 36
KBR 36
END
